rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for one's father and can also be a sexual or kink-style term of address in the right context.

example.jyutping: baa4 baa1 ngo5 faan1 lei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial word for the leading or most influential man in a group or field, rather than for an ordinary father.

example.english: Among these chefs, he’s the daddy.
example.traditional: 喺呢班廚師入面，佢先係大佬。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 baan1 cyu4 si1 jap6 min6 keoi5 sin1 hai6 daai6 lou2

rows.note: Use this spoken phrase for the standout or best one among several things, as in “the daddy of them all.”

example.english: Of all the desserts this time, this one is the daddy.
example.traditional: 今次啲甜品入面，呢個係最勁嗰個。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 di1 tim4 ban2 jap6 min6 ni1 go3 hai6 zeoi3 ging6 go2 go3
